questions.q: What does Banayan describe as the "third door" in success?
a: VIP entrance only for the elite
questions.why: He says success requires a sneaky, resourceful route beyond the first two doors.

questions.q: Which trait did all interviewees share according to Banahan?
questions.why: He notes persistence, specifically tenacity, was common among successful people.

questions.q: What fear held Bill Gates back before his famous call?
questions.why: Gates was scared to make the phone call, nearly missing his breakthrough.

questions.q: How did Walmart finally improve its market share?
a: Shifted mindset after a poster about Amazon
questions.why: An executive hung a poster, changed strategy, and share rose.

questions.q: What lesson does Banayan draw about copying others?
a: Success requires finding your own path
questions.why: He stresses you must define success yourself, not just copy.
